# Certrust

> Open-source infrastructure for issuing, verifying, and managing Open Badges 3.0 and W3C Verifiable Credentials. Self-hostable, API-first, standards-compliant.

Certrust lets organizations issue tamper-proof digital credentials (badges, certificates, diplomas) to recipients who can share and verify them publicly. Built on Open Badges 3.0 and W3C Verifiable Credentials standards.

## For organizations (no technical knowledge needed)

Certrust is for training providers, workshop and event organizers, schools, universities and anyone who gives out certificates. Upload a list of names and emails (or type one name), pick a certificate or badge design, and send. Each person receives their certificate by email, can add it to LinkedIn or share a link, and anyone can check it is genuine on a public page or by scanning its QR code, without an account.

- Typical uses: workshop and event attendance certificates, course completion certificates and diplomas, training that expires (first aid, safety, licences), badges for skills
- Send hundreds at once from a CSV file, or schedule them for the day of the ceremony
- Issue straight from Google Sheets, Google Forms, a student records system, or by asking Claude or ChatGPT (MCP connection)
- Pricing: pay $0.20 per certificate (smallest purchase 50), or a yearly plan. Recipients never pay. Details: https://certrust.app/solution
- Start here: https://certrust.app/get-started
- Step-by-step guide: https://certrust.app/guide/issue-your-first-certificate
- Check a certificate: https://certrust.app/verify
- Contact: support@certrust.app

## Key capabilities

- Issue Open Badges 3.0 credentials with cryptographic proof
- Verify credentials by URL or ID — publicly accessible, no login required
- Revoke and renew credentials
- Multi-tenant: multiple organizations in one deployment
- Batch issuance for large cohorts
- Self-hostable via Docker Compose or Kubernetes (Helm chart provided)
- Full REST API with versioning (`/api/v1`)
- Interactive CLI (`certrust` command) and MCP server for AI assistants

## API

- [OpenAPI / Swagger UI](https://api.certrust.app/documentation)
- [API base URL](https://api.certrust.app/api/v1)
- [Verify a credential](https://api.certrust.app/api/credentials/{id}/verify) — GET, no auth required
- [Health check](https://api.certrust.app/api/health)
- [Integration setup guide](https://certrust.app/integrations/guide) — API keys, issuing, rate limits, errors

## MCP Server (for AI assistants)

Certrust's MCP server is remote: `https://api.certrust.app/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
Connect with OAuth 2.1 (dynamic client registration + PKCE; a member approves the connection and its permissions) or send an organization API key as `Authorization: Bearer crt_...`. Pro and Enterprise plans.

For apps that only run local (stdio) servers, `@certrust/mcp` bridges to it:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "certrust": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@certrust/mcp"],
      "env": { "CERTRUST_API_KEY": "crt_... (Manage > API keys)" }
    }
  }
}
```

Setup guide: https://certrust.app/integrations/guide#ai-assistants
